description_en: Queries configured Web Application Firewall (WAF) mitigation policies
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafPolicies查询用户已配置的WAF防护策略详细信息
name: DescribeDcdnWafPolicies

parameters.help_en:
The conditional query, which is a JSON-serialized string. The format is as follows: `QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"mitigation policy ID","RuleIds":"mitigation rule ID range","PolicyNameLike":"mitigation policy name","DomainNames":"protected domain name","PolicyType":"default","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","PolicyStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

If this parameter is not specified, all mitigation policies are queried
parameters.help_zh:
按条件查询，JSON序列化后的字符串。
格式如下：```QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"防护策略ID","RuleIds":"防护规则ID范围","PolicyNameLike":"防护策略名称","DomainNames":"防护域名","PolicyType":"default","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","PolicyStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}```
不传默认查询所有防护策略
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of mitigation policies to return on each page. Default value: 20. Valid values: an integer from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的防护策略个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之前的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 页码。取值范围为：1~100000。默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of mitigation policies displayed on each page. Default value: 20. Valid values: an integer from 1 to 500
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的防护策略个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之前的任意整数

DefenseScene.description_en: The mitigation scenario. The value is the same as the \`DefenseScenes\` field in the \`QueryArgs\` request parameter
DefenseScene.description_zh: 防护策略类型，同请求参数QueryArgs中DefenseScenes

DomainCount.description_en: The number of domain names that use the mitigation policy
DomainCount.description_zh: 使用该防护策略的域名个数

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the policy was last modified. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the mitigation policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the mitigation policy

PolicyStatus.description_en: The status of the mitigation policy. The value is the same as the \`PolicyStatus\` field in the \`QueryArgs\` request parameter
PolicyStatus.description_zh: 防护策略状态，同请求参数QueryArgs中PolicyStatus

PolicyType.description_en: Indicates whether the policy is a default mitigation policy. The value is the same as the \`PolicyType\` field in the \`QueryArgs\` request parameter
PolicyType.description_zh: 是否为默认防护策略，同请求参数QueryArgs中PolicyType

RuleCount.description_en: The number of rules in the mitigation policy
RuleCount.description_zh: 该防护策略下的防护规则个数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of mitigation policies
